title: DNA Extraction Using Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit
author: Varsha Rajesh

steps.title: Prepare Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Isolate a cell pellet of approximately 30 uL in size.

substeps.instruction: If pellet is submerged in buffer (e.g., PBS): Mix pellet and PBS by pipetting, take a portion estimated to contain 30 uL of pellet, centrifuge at 8000 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature (RT), and remove supernatant.
If only cell pellet is provided: Note volume, add 1 mL PBS, mix, take a portion to obtain a 30 uL pellet, centrifuge at 8000 x g for 5 minutes at RT, and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Lysis and Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet and digest proteins.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 180 uL of Buffer ATL (lysis buffer).
Add 20 uL proteinase K and vortex to mix.
Incubate at 56°C for 20 minutes.
Vortex occasionally and mix with a p1000 pipet after the first 20-minute incubation to ensure the pellet is completely lysed.

steps.title: Optional RNA Removal
steps.instruction: Remove RNA if RNA-free genomic DNA is required.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 uL of 100 mg/mL RNase A and vortex to mix.
Incubate for 2 min at RT.
Add 200 uL of AL Buffer.
Vortex to mix and use a p1000 pipet to homogenize the solution as much as possible.
Incubate at 56°C for another 20 minutes.

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for column binding.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 uL of 96-100% ethanol to the sample and vortex to mix.
Use a p1000 pipet first, then a p200 pipet, to homogenize the solution until it is homogenous.

steps.title: DNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind DNA to the spin column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer mixture to a DNeasy Mini spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge at 9000 x g for 1 minute (RT).
Discard flow-through in liquid waste and the collection tube in solid waste.

steps.title: First Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA membrane with Buffer AW1.

substeps.instruction: Place column into a new 2 mL collection tube.
Add 500 uL of Buffer AW1.
Centrifuge at 9000 x g for 1 minute (RT).
Discard flow-through in liquid waste and the collection tube in solid waste.

steps.title: Second Wash and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA membrane with Buffer AW2 and dry.

substeps.instruction: Place column into a new 2 mL collection tube.
Add 500 uL of Buffer AW2.
Centrifuge at 20,000 x g for 3 minutes (RT) to dry the column membrane.
Discard flow-through in liquid waste and the collection tube in solid waste.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Place column into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 40 uL Buffer AE directly onto the column membrane.
Incubate at RT for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 9000 x g for 1 minute (RT) to elute.

steps.title: Optional Secondary Elution
steps.instruction: Increase DNA yield via repeat elution.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the elution step using either the eluate from the previous step (recommended) or an additional 40 uL of Buffer AE in a new microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Sample Storage
steps.instruction: Store the extracted DNA based on intended use duration.

substeps.instruction: Store at 4°C for immediate use.
Store at -20°C for short term storage.
Store at -80°C for long-term storage.

steps.title: DNA Quantification
steps.instruction: Determine DNA concentration and purity using a Nanodrop.

substeps.instruction: Use 1 uL of Buffer AE as the blank.
Use 1 uL of each sample to determine concentration.
Verify purity: A260/A280 ratio of ~1.8 indicates pure DNA; A260/A230 ratio of 2.0-2.2 indicates pure nucleic acid.
